data.description: BUILDPLAN M-57 · ACs AC-255 – AC-257 · SPEC Amendment 14 · US-77. Binding prototype: prototypes/pipeline-v1.1/index.html at v1.7 (drive it — every surface here is built and working there). Design reasoning: sequence/venue-map-ux.md. BLOCKING SEED DEFECT THIS TICKET OWNS. scripts/seed/event.ts lines 151-152 seed Sheraton and the Workshop Annex at IDENTICAL coordinates (40.7625188, -73.9814528) with access_minutes 0 on both. MRQ-58's migration is correct and the seed is faithful to SPEC section 6 as written — and the consequence is that the Transit conflict class can never fire and the site map stacks two pins on one point. The feature would pass its tests and be inert in the demo. SPEC Amendment 14 supersedes section 6's 'without inventing a second real venue' clause for exactly this reason. Re-seed so at least two buildings are genuinely apart in space with a non-zero access time on one. Confirm the second venue's identity with the operator before inventing one. Scope: - Third migration adding buildings.access_note TEXT. 0002 is merged and immutable; this is additive. - Move buildings AND rooms authoring to /settings/venues, beneath the site map their coordinates drive. Strip venue editors from /settings; leave a linking count. One shared writer behind both Save paths. - Move the photo-ID/security sentence off its room note onto the building's access_note. Entrance instructions belong to the building; rooms inherit. - Site map as a TILE MOSAIC, not a map library: plain OSM rasters on a centre-clipped fixed-width plane, pins and walking lines drawn over. Fixed-aspect reserved box so arriving tiles never shift layout. Attribution visible. Tile failure degrades to pins over the graph-paper grid, never a blank box. No Leaflet, no CDN, no API key — the repo goes public. Watch for: a handler bound only to the settings route leaves '+ Add building' inert on /settings/venues. AC-256 exists to catch exactly that.
data.title: Venue geography — access_note, the Venues screen, and a seed that can conflict

data.body:
**OPERATOR RULING on the open venue question — resolved, build against this.**

The second venue is a **real, genuinely separate NYC venue near the Sheraton**, not the 2025 building set and not a same-address annex.

- **Keep the 2026 Sheraton story.** `Sheraton New York Times Square, 811 7th Ave` stays the primary venue with its verified coordinate.
- **Replace "Workshop Annex — Lower Conference Level"** with a real, verifiable Midtown venue a short walk away — far enough that `access_minutes` is genuinely non-zero (target ~8–12 minutes on foot), close enough to be plausible overflow space for one conference.
- **Do not invent a venue.** Use a real place with a real street address, and derive `lat`/`lng` from that address rather than fabricating a coordinate. If you cannot verify a coordinate, say so and stop rather than guessing — this repo is public and a fake pin on a real map is the kind of detail that reads as sloppy.
- `Online` stays unpinned; a virtual venue has no honest map position.

**Why this and not the alternatives:** the real 2025 set (Times Center, Jay Suites, AWS JFK27) is geographically real but chronologically wrong for a 2026 Sheraton conference, and it pairs Sheraton-native room names with 2025 buildings — incoherent in the other direction. Keeping one venue and cutting the feature would ship a conflict class that provably never fires.

**Root cause, for the record:** the identical coordinates trace to the orchestrator's own Amendment 11 ruling, which made the Annex the Sheraton's *lower conference level*. That is internally coherent and is exactly why travel time is zero by construction. SPEC Amendment 14 supersedes it.

**Consequences you own:**
- `scripts/seed/event.ts:151-152` — the two identical `40.7625188, -73.9814528` rows with `access_minutes 0`.
- **AC-259 must actually fire:** `check:seed` has to observe a live Transit conflict in the seeded data, not merely a non-zero column.
- **Prototype v1.7 is the binding design contract and currently shows the 2025 buildings — it must be brought into agreement with this ruling.** Flag to the orchestrator when your change lands so the prototype and the build do not diverge.
- **MRQ-10 has been told to stop building venue editors**: buildings and rooms authoring is yours at `/settings/venues` (AC-256), and **AC-252/AC-253 move to this ticket**. MRQ-10 ships details/formats/tracks with a link through to your surface.
